_readme: Photo directories and caption files whose IATA code cannot be a filename on
Windows. `AUX` is a legacy DOS device name: `public/photos/AUX/` resolves to
the device rather than a directory, and git cannot index anything under it
(`open(...): No such file or directory`). The escaped stem below is what
actually lives on disk; readers map code -> stem through this table:
lib/airport-photos.ts                 gallery paths and caption lookup
scripts/generate-airport-guides.mjs   inline photo block in generated guides
The manifest key and the `captions.tw.json` key stay the real IATA code.
